# jreact.com

> A comprehensive guide to reactive programming on the JVM, covering frameworks like Vert.x, Project Reactor, and RxJava with practical tutorials and design patterns.

jreact.com provides in-depth documentation and tutorials for building event-driven, non-blocking applications using Java and JVM-based reactive frameworks. The site covers both foundational concepts like the Observer Pattern and advanced topics including distributed messaging, database integration, and web server development.

## Key Topics

- Vert.x
- Project Reactor
- RxJava
- Reactive Streams
- Reactive Programming
- Observer Pattern
- Event-Driven Architecture
- Event Bus
- Verticles
- Non-Blocking I/O
- Backpressure
- JVM
- Java
- Hibernate Reactive
- Event Handling

## Reactive Frameworks

- [Vert.x](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x): Guide to Eclipse Vert.x: open-source reactive framework for event-driven design
- [Project Reactor](https://jreact.com/index.php/project-reactor): Guide to Project Reactor: non-blocking reactive programming for JVM with backpressure
- [ReactiveX / RxJava](https://jreact.com/index.php/reactivex): RxJava tutorial with Flowable and Observable examples for reactive programming
- [Reactive Java Libraries](https://jreact.com/index.php/reactive-java-libraries): Reference overview of reactive Java libraries: RxJava, Project Reactor, Akka Streams

## Vert.x Deep Dive

- [Verticles](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x/verticles): Tutorial on Vert.x Verticles: deployable code chunks with event loop and examples
- [Deploying a Verticle](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x/deploying-a-verticle): How-to guide for deploying Verticles in Vert.x with code examples
- [Event Bus](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x/event-bus): Tutorial on Vert.x EventBus for inter-verticle messaging and distributed communication
- [Web](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x/web): Guide to Vert.x-Web for HTTP server routing and request handling
- [Hibernate Reactive](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x/hibernate-reactive): Tutorial on Hibernate Reactive with Vert.x and PostgreSQL with code examples
- [Packaging](https://jreact.com/index.php/vert-x/packaging): Guide to packaging Vert.x applications using maven-shade-plugin and fat JAR

## Reactive Programming Fundamentals

- [Intro](https://jreact.com/index.php/intro-2): Introduction to reactive programming tools: RxJS, Project Reactor, RxJava, and frameworks
- [Observer Pattern](https://jreact.com/index.php/observer-pattern): Tutorial on Observer Pattern design pattern with Java implementation and examples
- [Observable Class](https://jreact.com/index.php/observer-pattern/observable-class-in-java): Reference for Java Observable class methods: setChanged() and notifyObservers()

## Navigation & Overview

- [Homepage](https://jreact.com): Homepage covering AI trends, ML tutorials, and data science with tools like DuckDB and scikit-learn
- [Main Menu](https://jreact.com/index.php/menu-main): Main navigation menu for jreact.com technology categories and frameworks overview
- [Reactive Programming Menu](https://jreact.com/index.php/menu-main-reactive-programming): Navigation menu for reactive programming frameworks including Vert.x and Kafka Streams
